info.title: Quartermaster AI + TrustRail API
info.description: Autonomous procurement secured by TrustRail. Amounts are integer minor units. Mutations require `X-Requested-With: quartermaster`; routes marked idempotent require an `Idempotency-Key` header. Response shapes are defined in packages/contracts/src/dto.ts.
